lines.speaker: Barkeep
lines.text: The Eastern Reach has been quiet lately. Too quiet, if you ask me.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: I served under Commander Aldric before the withdrawal. Good soldier, shame about how it ended.

lines.speaker: Liandra
lines.text: The forest spirits have gone silent. Something stirs in the deep woods.

lines.speaker: Barkeep
lines.text: First night through, things haven't been the same. But we endure.
